description: Routing eval for the home-lab operations overlap: homelab-platform (agent) vs its three skills service-onboard, lab-audit, runbook. All four share vocabulary — 'my lab', 'a service', 'check', 'docs' — over a LIVE lab, so a misroute here is the most consequential in the fleet (e.g. a read-only question landing on a mutating path). Positives name the specific intended member; negatives share lab/service/check/write vocabulary but must route to NO cluster member.
notes: This is the BASELINE of the current members, seeded before the planned incident / restore-drill / upgrade-campaign skills land (docs/skills-modernization-plan.md); re-run and diff after they are added. Grading (scripts/eval_routing.py): a positive passes if any member in expect_fires fired; a negative passes only if NO member fired. Two watch items specific to this cluster: (1) service-onboard sets disable-model-invocation but ships as a plugin skill, so per anthropics/claude-code#22345 it may fire directly on 'add a service' prompts even though the intended owner is homelab-platform (which reads it by path); a positive that fires service-onboard instead of homelab-platform is the open /code-review finding, not a clean pass. (2) lab-shaping ARCHITECTURE (storage/network layout) is routed up the ladder by homelab-platform's Boundaries, not to the cluster — the neg-lab-architecture case guards that seam.

cases.prompt: Add Jellyfin to my home lab — set up the container behind the reverse proxy with TLS.
cases.expected_output: Routes to homelab-platform, which owns change authority and works the service-onboard checklist by path. Watch: service-onboard firing as a direct Skill call (per #22345) instead of homelab-platform is the open routing residual, not the intended path.

cases.prompt: My Pi-hole container was set up ad-hoc — no health check, no backups, no runbook. Bring it up to standard.
cases.expected_output: The 'bring an existing ad-hoc service up to standard' path — homelab-platform working the service-onboard checklist under its tiers.

cases.prompt: My reverse proxy keeps returning 502 for the Grafana route. Figure out why and fix it.
cases.expected_output: Troubleshooting live infrastructure — homelab-platform, under its change tiers (the fix is a Tier 2 apply).

cases.prompt: Pin the Jellyfin image off :latest to a specific version and restart the stack.
cases.expected_output: A deliberate versioned change to a running stack — homelab-platform's worked Tier 2 example is literally this.

cases.prompt: What's wrong with my home lab? Do a health and hygiene sweep and tell me what needs attention.
cases.expected_output: A read-only survey — lab-audit, which reports severity-ranked findings and hands fixes to homelab-platform.

cases.prompt: Audit my lab — is anything exposed to the internet, are any certs about to expire, any containers still on :latest?
cases.expected_output: Exposure/certificate/version checks are lab-audit's Checks list; read-only.

cases.prompt: Write a runbook for my Postgres container: how to check it's healthy, restart it, and recover it from backup.
cases.expected_output: An operating doc to the fixed runbook template — the runbook skill.

cases.prompt: Update the operating doc for Nextcloud with the new restart-and-verify procedure.
Add a CSV export feature to my web app's reports page.
cases.expected_output: Application code — routes to a builder (sde-fullstack / frontend-craft), not lab ops. 'Add' is shared vocabulary with add-a-service.

cases.prompt: Review my deploy script's pull request for security bugs before I merge it.
cases.expected_output: Reviewing a diff — code-reviewer. 'Deploy' and 'review' share vocabulary with lab work but this is a code review.

cases.prompt: My integration test for the API fails about one run in five. Find out why.
cases.expected_output: Debugging a flaky test — root-cause. 'Find out why' shares vocabulary with troubleshooting, but there is no lab here.

cases.prompt: Write API documentation for the public functions in my Python library.
cases.expected_output: Library API docs are not an ops runbook — must NOT fire runbook. 'Write documentation' is the tight near-miss for runbook.

cases.prompt: I'm planning the next two years of my lab — should I run Ceph or ZFS for storage, and how should I segment the VLANs?
cases.expected_output: Lab-shaping architecture on a multi-year horizon — routes UP the ladder (distinguished/principal) per homelab-platform's Boundaries, not to the ops cluster. Guards the eng-ladder-vs-homelab seam. 'Lab' and 'storage' are shared vocabulary.

cases.prompt: Build a status-page dashboard that reads services.json and shows each service's health.
cases.expected_output: A UI build — frontend-craft / sde-fullstack. 'Services' and 'health' share vocabulary with lab monitoring, but this is app code.

cases.prompt: My Claude Code skill for lab tasks never triggers when I ask it. Fix its description.
cases.expected_output: Prompt tooling — prompt-craft / prompt-engineer. The word 'lab' is a decoy; the task is fixing a description.
